<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "Entity-Value">
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY pe-ent 'Parameter-Entity-Value'>">
  %pe;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/ns/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment containing various constructs & ent; and <![CDATA[ inside comment -->
  <section id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with <tags> and &entities; unparsed.
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section id="s2">
    &ent; and &pe-ent; usage with processing instruction:
    <?target data="test"?>
  </section>
</catalog>

  <!ELEMENT root (node*)>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtd-macro;
  <!ENTITY dynamic "Resolved &inner;">
  <!ENTITY inner "BaseEntity">
]>
<?xml-process-instruction step="init" status="ok"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Comment 1: Testing DTD parameter entities expansion -->
  <node>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section 1: nested markup <node>&dynamic;</node>
    ]]>
  </node>
  <!-- Comment 2: Testing processing instruction inside body -->
  <?sub:pi data="value"?>
  <node>&dynamic;</node>
</root>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY file-ent SYSTEM "file:///etc/hosts">
  <!ENTITY % ext-pe SYSTEM "http://example.org/dtd-ext.ent">
  %ext-pe;
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" target="stdout"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Outer comment block detailing the archive structure and security notes -->
  <dc:title>Archive Document</dc:title>
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      Protected CDATA zone containing entities &file-ent;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <?xml-info version="1.0"?>
  <item>&file-ent;</item>
</archive>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha Entity">
  <!ENTITY beta "α + Beta Entity">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.org/inventory" xmlns:loc="http://example.org/inventory/loc">
  <!-- Detailed inventory comment with entity references β -->
  <stock loc:warehouse="central">
    <![CDATA[
      <stock-item id="001">
        Data inside CDATA with special chars <>&"'
      </stock-item>
    ]]>
  </stock>
  <?loc:audit status="verified" timestamp="2023-10-01"?>
  <stock>β</stock>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref1 "Reference 1">
  <!ENTITY ref2 "&ref1; and Reference 2">
  <!ENTITY % meta-macro "<!ENTITY internal-macro 'MacroValue'>">
  %meta-macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<database xmlns="http://example.org/db" xmlns:meta="http://example.org/db/meta" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Multi-line comment explaining the database structure, CDATA usage, and namespace bindings -->
  <meta:config>
    <?meta-action type="refresh"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <config-block>
        <setting name="mode">strict</setting>
        <data>&internal-macro;</data>
      </config-block>
    ]]>
  </meta:config>
  <record>&ref2;</record>
  <record>&internal-macro;</record>
</database>
